page_title: CHE 0-2 MCI | Chelsea v Manchester City 18/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+5' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) picks up a pass and hits the ball towards the top of the net, but he can't generate enough power to trouble Ederson.
90+4' The attendance for today's match is 39818.
90+4' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
90+2' A pass from Malo Gusto gives Cole Palmer (Chelsea) a shooting opportunity on the edge of the box, but the effort is poor and goes well wide of the right post.
90+2' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and signals a foul after Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) brought his opponent down. Chelsea are awarded the free kick.
90' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) announces himself with a close-range shot after a cross, but one of the defenders gets in the way of the ball to thwart him.
90' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
90' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
89' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) is given a fully deserved yellow card.
88' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Marc Guiu (Chelsea) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
84' 0 - 2 What a beauty from just outside the box! Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) lashed the ball with incredible pace and power inside the left post.
82' Phil Foden (Manchester City) tries to find Erling Haaland, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
80' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) is substituted due to injury. Enzo Maresca gives a chance to Renato Veiga.
80' The injury to Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) looks like it might have ended his involvement in this match.
78' Pedro Neto (Chelsea) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
78' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a wonderful cross from the corner kick. However, the defence works perfectly to clear the ball and avert the threat.
77' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
76' 6:9 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams. The number of shots on goal at present is 2:4.
74' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) quickly takes the corner kick with a short pass.
74' Rico Lewis (Manchester City) tries to send the ball in front of the goal, but the opposition's defence averts the threat. Manchester City have been awarded a corner kick.
73' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and releases a promising effort. Unfortunately for him, his strike flies painfully close to the right post.
71' Marc Cucurella (Chelsea) serves up a nice cross, but Ederson punches the ball away.
68' A long cross from the side is directed to the well-positioned Malo Gusto (Chelsea), but the defence gets it clear.
67' Here is a change. Romeo Lavia is going off and Enzo Maresca gives the last tactical orders to Kiernan Dewsbury-Hall (Chelsea).
67' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Nicolas Jackson departs the field of play to be replaced by Marc Guiu (Chelsea).
66' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) is rightly booked by the referee because it could not have been anything other than a yellow card.
66' Goal disallowed! Rico Lewis (Manchester City) scores but Anthony Taylor blows his whistle for a foul.
64' A cross by Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
62' Moises Caicedo (Chelsea) swings it in and Pedro Neto gets on the end of it, but Ederson shows good awareness and comes off his line to thwart the move.

61' It's unbelievable, Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) blows a huge opportunity! He is totally unmarked and fires a first-time shot towards goal from a few yards out, but Ederson reacts superbly to keep the ball out.
60' The corner from Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) is hurriedly cleared.

59' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. The ball is out of play. Chelsea win a corner kick.
58' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Christopher Nkunku leaves the pitch and Pedro Neto (Chelsea) comes on.
57' Good defending. Cole Palmer (Chelsea) tries to find Malo Gusto inside the box, but the pass is cut out.

54' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) carelessly slides into the feet of his opponent and he'll be lucky to avoid punishment. Anthony Taylor blows for the foul but keeps his cards in his pocket on this occasion.
52' Erling Haaland (Manchester City) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
51' Romeo Lavia (Chelsea) sends a long cross over to Nicolas Jackson, but Ederson comes forward to gather the ball.
49' Some great controlled play and passing from Manchester City. They are increasing their possession of the ball and trying to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
47' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
46' Pep Guardiola makes a switch. Phil Foden is coming on in place of Savinho (Manchester City) at the start of the second period.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+7' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+6' A pass lands at the feet of Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender.
45+4' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
45+4' PENALTY APPEAL after Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
45+3' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) passes the ball onto Bernardo Silva, but one of the defenders dispossesses him.
45+1' The goal by Chelsea won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
45' We will have 5 min. of added time.
45' Wait! Referee Anthony Taylor immediately makes the VAR signal, most likely to see if there was an offside in the build-up play.
45' GOAL DISALLOWED! Controversy and anger as Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) has a goal ruled out, incredibly, for offside.

44' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) meets a delivery on the edge of the penalty area and shoots towards to the bottom left corner. He didn't put enough power into the effort, though, and Ederson pulls off an easy save.
43' Savinho (Manchester City) is able to continue to play.
41' The game is interrupted now, Savinho (Manchester City) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.

40' A loose ball is pounced on by Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom left corner, but Robert Sanchez is alert and makes a comfortable save.
39' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.
39' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) misses a good chance to score. An inch-perfect cross into the box finds Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) who rises for a header, but sends the ball well over the bar.
38' Josko Gvardiol (Manchester City) connects with a pass but sees his shot from the edge of the box blocked.
38' The resulting corner from Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) is cleared by the opposition's defence.

37' A dangerous attempt from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) was aimed towards the roof of the net, but Robert Sanchez pulls off a superb save and stops this one. Manchester City force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
35' Nicolas Jackson (Chelsea) makes a run beyond the last defender, but he's offside.
35' Mateo Kovacic (Manchester City) collects a pass and finds himself in a good position to strike from the edge of the box, but his attempt is blocked.
34' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) attempted to pick out a free teammate inside the box, but Ederson comes off the line to clear the ball away.
33' Enzo Fernandez (Chelsea) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
30' Savinho (Manchester City) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
29' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Ederson intercepts the ball.
29' Good movement by Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea), but he can't find any of his teammates as the cross is poor.
26' The referee blows his whistle for a foul after Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) overruns the ball during an attack and makes an aggressive challenge on his opponent.
26' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Anthony Taylor signals.
25' Total attempts – 1:4. We can have a look at the statistics now, shots on target are 0:1.
22' Savinho races towards the box before laying off to Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City), who picks it up but drags a shot well wide of the right post from the edge of the box.
21' No offside! Referee Anthony Taylor points to the centre spot to indicate that the goal stands after the VAR review. The Manchester City players celebrate.
20' Hold on! There’s a VAR review to see whether there was an offside in the build up to the goal. The referee is checking now. The Manchester City players aren’t happy.

18' 0 - 1 Goal! Erling Haaland (Manchester City) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Bernardo Silva inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball into the middle of the goal. 0:1.
16' Kevin De Bruyne (Manchester City) sends a cross into the box, but Robert Sanchez comes off his line to gather the ball.
13' Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) commits a foul and Anthony Taylor immediately signals a free kick.
11' Rico Lewis sprays a pass out to Jeremy Doku (Manchester City), but he produces a poor effort from inside the box which goes well wide of the left post.
10' Wesley Fofana (Chelsea) cracks a volley from just outside the box, but his miskick goes skyward.
10' Cole Palmer (Chelsea) takes the corner with a short pass.
9' Malo Gusto (Chelsea) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The linesman points to the corner flag, Chelsea are going to take it.
9' The ball goes out of play. Manchester City are awarded a corner kick.

9' Bernardo Silva (Manchester City) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Manchester City.
8' Robert Sanchez (Chelsea) sends a long ball forward to Christopher Nkunku, but he put too much power and the chance is gone. The ball is out of play. Manchester City will take a throw-in.
5' Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.

4' The cross into the penalty area from Jeremy Doku (Manchester City) needed to be more accurate in order to create a goal-scoring opportunity for his team. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Chelsea.
4' Anthony Taylor blows his whistle and it's Christopher Nkunku (Chelsea) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
3' Savinho (Manchester City) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Robert Sanchez, who smothers the ball.
2' A cross is clipped into the penalty area by Rico Lewis (Manchester City) but poses no threat. The ball goes out of play and Chelsea will have a goal kick.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
The players are on the pitch and Manchester City will have the kick-off.
Anthony Taylor was nominated as the referee for this game.
